purpose: fix a confirmed defect with the smallest safe change and prove it with a test that failed before
entry_criteria: Defect is reproduced and has a ticket with steps and expected behavior
The affected version and area of code are known
procedure: Write a failing test that reproduces the defect before touching the code.
Find the root cause; fix the cause rather than the symptom, with the smallest change.
Confirm the new test passes and the surrounding tests still pass.
Check related code paths for the same mistake and note or fix them.
Describe cause, fix and risk in the pull request and link the ticket.
After release, confirm with the reporter or monitoring that the defect no longer occurs.
deliverables: pull request with cause and risk
acceptance_criteria: The regression test fails without the fix and passes with it
The change is limited to the defect
Reporter or monitoring confirms the fix
validation_method: Service owner acceptance and customer-facing closure check.

validation.command: git stash && pytest -q tests/regression/test_bug_1234.py; git stash pop && pytest -q tests/regression/test_bug_1234.py   # example
validation.expect: fails before the fix, passes after

failure_modes.detection: Test does not fail on the old code
failure_modes.response: Rewrite the test to reproduce the defect

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: Totals are off by one cent for certain discounts. A test with that discount fails; the rounding is moved to the end of the calculation; the test and suite pass; the finance team confirms next day.
